title: Let holy company cool the body
summary: Holy company cools the body before the mind can settle. Take the agitation where patient remembrance can reach the breath first.
takeaway: Take the agitated body to remembering company and let it cool there.
lifeApplication: When agitation reaches the body, do not argue yourself calm. Sit near people whose remembrance slows the breath and lets the body cool.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company cools the body before the mind can settle.
source.lifeApplication: When agitation reaches the body, sit where patient people remember God.
